taiwan.overview: Taiwan offers walking from the marble walls of Taroko Gorge to the high-altitude trails of the Central Mountain Range. The main route is the demanding ascent of Yushan, a two-day trek to a 12,970-foot summit that requires a lottery permit. Day hikers can tackle the exposed Zhuilu Old Road cliff path in Taroko, which also needs a permit, or ride the forest railway to Alishan for walks among ancient cypress trees. October and November bring the clearest skies and most comfortable temperatures for the trails.

months.2: Snow lingers on the high peaks, while lower trails in the south offer pleasant walking. The north stays grey and wet.
months.6: Heat and humidity build across the island, making steep climbs exhausting. Early morning starts are essential for day hikes, and afternoon thunderstorms frequently wash out the high mountain views.
months.10: This is the best month for walking in Taiwan, with clear skies and comfortable temperatures. The views from Yushan are spectacular, and the exposed cliff trails in Taroko Gorge are in excellent condition.

tanzania.overview: Northern Tanzania's walking centers on Mount Kilimanjaro, an expedition trek that takes walkers to the roof of Africa without technical climbing gear. Multi-day routes like the Machame, Lemosho, and the hut-to-hut Marangu trail climb through rainforest and alpine desert to a glaciated summit. Beyond the big peak, visitors can take on the steep multi-day trek up Mount Meru or walk the forested rim of the Ngorongoro Crater. All Kilimanjaro and Meru routes require mandatory registered guides and park fees.

months.9: September maintains excellent trekking conditions. The trails are dry, and the summit push on Kilimanjaro benefits from clear, predictable weather.

tasmania.overview: Tasmania offers dramatic walking, from the dolerite peaks of Cradle Mountain to the white sands of Freycinet. The island is famous for the Overland Track, a six-day, 40-mile alpine trek through the central highlands that needs an advance booking from October to May. Day hikers can tackle the steep, rocky ascent of Cradle Mountain or the coastal trails above Wineglass Bay. The best conditions run from December to February, while the middle of the year brings snow and harsh weather to the highlands.

tbilisi-caucasus.overview: The Georgian Caucasus offers spectacular mountain walking, from day hikes to remote glaciers to multi-day village routes. The famous four-day, 34-mile trek from Mestia to Ushguli in Svaneti connects ancient stone towers via guesthouse stays. Day hikers heading north from Tbilisi can tackle the steep 3.7-mile round trip to the Gergeti Trinity Church, or push further on the long 12-mile round trip to the Gergeti Glacier. The high mountain routes are fully open from July through September.

months.1: Deep snow blankets the high Caucasus, and the famous Svaneti treks are out of reach. Walking means low-elevation valley paths near Tbilisi or snowshoe routes in the foothills.
months.2: Snow cover holds across the high Caucasus. The lower valleys near Tbilisi and the foothills offer the only practical walking.
months.12: Winter snow covers the high mountains, leaving low valley paths near Tbilisi and snowshoe routes in the foothills as the options.
months.7: The high Caucasus is at its peak. The 34-mile Mestia to Ushguli trek is clear of snow, and the long climb to the Gergeti Glacier offers spectacular views of the peaks.
months.8: Settled summer weather keeps the high routes open. The Mestia to Ushguli trek links stone-tower villages, and the Gergeti Trinity Church path leads to wide views of the surrounding peaks.
months.9: Clear skies and crisp air make this an excellent month for the high routes. The Mestia to Ushguli trek and the steep climb to Gergeti Trinity Church offer great walking conditions.

texas-hill-country.overview: The Texas Hill Country offers modest but scenic day hikes through limestone canyons, oak woodlands, and river valleys. The standout route is the short, steep walk up the pink granite dome of Enchanted Rock, which needs a reservation on busy days. Trails are mostly short and gentle, with the best walking found in the region's state parks.

months.12: Mild winter temperatures make for comfortable day hikes, especially on the exposed trails that are too hot in summer.

months.1: The dry weather makes this the best time for jungle trails. Paths are firm, and the humidity is as low as it gets.
months.2: Dry, sunny days continue, with firm paths through the rainforest, though an early start still beats the heat.
months.12: Dry weather brings firm paths and lower humidity to the jungle trails, and an early start still helps.
months.6: The monsoon brings heavy, regular rain. Jungle trails are slick and muddy, and low cloud often hides the coastal viewpoints.
months.7: Rain falls most days, keeping the jungle trails slick and muddy.
months.8: Wet-season downpours continue, and low cloud regularly hides the viewpoints above the Andaman Sea.
Snow remains deep across the region. Walking is confined to low-elevation winter paths, and the mountain trails are out of reach.
months.10: The thaw opens more trails in the national park, though higher elevations hold snow and the Dientes de Navarino passes are not yet open.
